claims: C1 the system level sits below root and above developer, user, and guideline in the authority hierarchy
C2 system-level instructions can only be supplied by OpenAI
C3 OpenAI may supply system-level instructions through this Model Spec or through detailed policies
C4 OpenAI may supply system-level instructions via a system message

concepts.name: system_level_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction at the system level of authority

concepts.name: openai_supplied_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction whose source is the OpenAI organization, as opposed to a developer or user

concepts.name: supplied_via_model_spec
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction whose content is set out in the Model Spec document itself

concepts.name: supplied_via_detailed_policy
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction whose content is set out in a detailed policy document

concepts.name: supplied_via_system_message
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction whose content is conveyed in a system message

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: system_authority
concepts.gloss: the system level of instruction authority: rules set by OpenAI that can be transmitted or overridden through system messages, but cannot be overridden by developers or users

ontology.gloss: I is a system-level instruction supplied by OpenAI through this Model Spec
I is a system-level instruction supplied by OpenAI through a detailed policy
I is a system-level instruction supplied by OpenAI via a system message
